validation_notes: The right side of the chart (mid-June through late July) shows a recovery from ~1600 lows to a consolidation around 1850-1950, but this is more of a flat, range-bound sideways channel than a converging triangle. Highs are roughly flat (~1950) and lows are roughly flat (~1830-1870), showing parallel-ish boundaries rather than clear convergence. There's no strong evidence of narrowing range or an apex forming - price has been oscillating in a tight horizontal band for the last several weeks without the progressively tightening highs/lows needed for a symmetric triangle. I don't see 3+ converging touch points on both sides that are clearly angling toward each other; it reads more like consolidation/basing after a downtrend than a triangle breakout setup.
